# 差异分析

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: difference-load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(patchwork)
library(jsonlite)
source("figure-notes.R")
```

## 构建 microtable 对象

```{r}
#| label: difference-create-microtable
otu_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
        group = factor(group, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
        breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire")),
        genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
    )
taxon_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

mt <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
has_valid_taxa <- any(!is.na(taxon_table$Genus) & taxon_table$Genus != "" & taxon_table$Genus != "Unclassified")
```

## 保留高丰度物种

高丰度物种是我们重点关注的分类群。过滤保留平均相对丰度 > 1% 的属。

```{r}
#| label: filter-abundant
mt$cal_abund()

# 保留平均相对丰度 > 0.1% 的属
if (has_valid_taxa) {
    mt$taxa_abund$Genus <- mt$taxa_abund$Genus[rowMeans(mt$taxa_abund$Genus) > 0.001, ]
}

# 同步更新其它表
mt$tidy_dataset()
```

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy-status
if (!has_valid_taxa) {
    cat("当前分类表没有有效属水平注释（SILVA 数据库缺失时会标记为 Unclassified）。差异分类群分析已跳过；提供 SILVA_DB_FILE 并重新运行 DADA2 注释后可启用本章分析。\n")
}
```

## 按品种的差异分析

```{r}
#| label: fig-lefse-breed
#| fig-cap: "品种间 LEfSe 差异菌属 LDA 得分图。"
#| warning: false
t2 = trans_diff$new(
    dataset = mt,
    method = "lefse",
    group = "breed",
    alpha = 0.05,
    taxa_level = "Genus"
)

t2$plot_diff_bar(use_number = 1:20)
```


```{r}
#| label: note-lefse-breed
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("lefse-breed")
```
